title: High-Density Diffuse Optical Tomography Audiovisual Movie Viewing Dataset
description: This dataset contains high-density diffuse optical tomography (HD-DOT) recordings from 5 participants performing functional localizer tasks and audiovisual movie viewing. Data are provided in SNIRF format together with optode and landmark locations linked to subject-specific head models. It supports research on mapping brain function during naturalistic viewing and on decoding multisensory stimuli.
methods_description: Participants completed functional localizer and movie viewing tasks while HD-DOT data were recorded. Data are stored in SNIRF format with optode and landmark locations associated with subject-specific head models.
